Section 1.  Tenant’s Insurance.  Tenant shall maintain, at its sole cost and expense, throughout the Term: (a) commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 aggregate; (b) umbrella or excess liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000 following form over commercial general liability, automobile, and employer’s liability coverage; (c) professional and medical malpractice liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per claim and $3,000,000 aggregate, with tail coverage after termination if written on a claims-made basis; (d) property insurance at full replacement cost covering Tenant’s improvements, clinical build-out, personal property, and medical equipment; (e) workers’ compensation at statutory limits and employer’s liability insurance; (f) business interruption and extra-expense coverage sufficient to fund at least twelve (12) months of rent; and (g) pollution or environmental liability insurance if Tenant handles regulated medical waste, hazardous drugs, or radiologic materials. Landlord, its property manager, and its lender shall be additional insureds on a primary and non-contributory basis under the commercial general liability, automobile, umbrella, and pollution policies, with waiver of subrogation in their favor. Policies shall be issued by insurers rated A-VIII or better and provide thirty (30) days’ prior notice of cancellation or material reduction where commercially available. Tenant shall deliver certificates before the Commencement Date and annually thereafter.
